$description: The dongle's status LED, the same in every theme: colors at full brightness (the dongle dims them). Design Tokens Format (DTCG).

advertising.$description: Slow pulse: waiting for the phone

connected.$description: Short glow when the phone connects

security-key.$description: Double blink: a security key request waits for a touch

drive.$description: Faint slow pulse while a computer has the dongle's drive: don't unplug
